title: API key rotation
body: Production API keys are rotated every 60 days.

title: Password reset
body: Employees must reset temporary passwords within 24 hours of issue.

title: Incident escalation
body: A severity one incident must be escalated to the response lead within 15 minutes.

title: Backup frequency
body: Encrypted backups run every six hours and are retained for 30 days.

title: Recovery drills
body: Disaster recovery restoration drills are performed on the first Monday of each quarter.

title: Travel receipts
body: Travel expense receipts must be submitted within 10 business days of return.

title: Remote work
body: Remote employees must use the company VPN on untrusted networks.

title: Visitor badges
body: All office visitors receive a temporary badge that expires at 6 PM the same day.

title: Lost badges
body: A lost employee building badge must be reported to security within one hour.

title: Equipment return
body: Company laptops must be returned within five business days of offboarding.

title: Annual training
body: Security awareness training is required annually for all employees.

title: Vendor assessment
body: High-risk suppliers undergo a formal assessment every 12 months.

title: Change approval
body: Production deployments require review and approval by two independent maintainers.

title: Release freeze
body: Production releases are frozen between December 20 and January 3.

title: Service monitoring
body: Critical service health checks execute every two minutes.

title: Audit log retention
body: System audit logs are retained for 400 days in encrypted storage.

title: Data exports
body: Customer export requests are fulfilled within seven business days after verification.

title: Access reviews
body: Privileged user permissions are reviewed every 90 days.

title: New-hire onboarding
body: New employees complete the security checklist before receiving production access.

title: Phishing reports
body: Suspected phishing messages must be forwarded to the security mailbox immediately.

title: Transport encryption
body: Public APIs must support TLS version 1.3 or newer.

title: Emergency patching
body: Critical security patches are deployed within 48 hours of validation.

title: SSH key policy
body: Employee SSH keys must be renewed once every 180 days.

title: Secrets storage
body: Production service credentials must be kept in the managed secrets vault.

title: Project archiving
body: Inactive project repositories are archived after 120 days without activity.

title: Survey privacy
body: Anonymous staff surveys suppress results for groups smaller than seven people.

title: Meeting notes
body: Internal meeting notes are published to the team portal within two business days.

title: Office hours
body: The facilities help desk operates from 8 AM until 6 PM on weekdays.

title: Pull request review
body: Each feature pull request requires at least one independent reviewer.

title: Load testing
body: Customer-facing services receive a load test before each quarterly major release.

title: Database migration
body: Schema migrations must include a documented rollback procedure.

title: Response-time target
body: The standard support response-time target is four business hours.

title: Risk register
body: Product risk registers are reviewed by owners every month.

title: User interviews
body: Product research interviews require recorded consent before any recording begins.

title: Data deletion
body: Verified account deletion requests are completed within 30 calendar days.

title: Service accounts
body: Service account permissions must follow least privilege and have a named owner.

title: Contract review
body: Legal review is required for vendor contracts exceeding 25000 dollars.

title: Meal reimbursement
body: Meal reimbursement is limited to 35 dollars per employee per day.

title: Community events
body: Public community events require an accessibility checklist before publication.

title: Support triage
body: Incoming urgent support tickets are triaged within 20 minutes.

title: Label versioning
body: Training data label schema changes must increment the dataset version number.

title: Metrics alerts
body: Metric alert rules receive a monthly false-positive review.

title: Hardware inventory
body: Assigned workstations are inventoried twice each year.

title: Device lock
body: Managed devices lock automatically after ten idle minutes.

title: Room reservations
body: Meeting rooms may be reserved at most 45 days ahead.

title: Conference attendance
body: International conference travel requires manager signoff before booking.

title: Contractor access
body: Contractor production access expires automatically after 14 days.
